name: com.workel/mcp
description: Official Model Context Protocol server for Workel — a thin, stateless client of the Workel Public API v1. Exposes read-only tools for projects, tasks, task comments, members, and events to any MCP-speaking AI client. Holds no authority beyond what the configured API key's scopes already grant.

environmentVariables.name: WORKEL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A Workel API key minted in Workel → Settings → Developers. Read only from this environment variable, never from a command-line argument — those are visible via `ps` to any local user on the machine.

environmentVariables.name: WORKEL_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the API host. Defaults to https://api.workel.com/api/public/v1. Must be https://, except http://localhost, http://127.0.0.1, or http://[::1], which are allowed for local development.

environmentVariables.name: WORKEL_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Local operator consent flag for write tools — not an authorization boundary. No write tool is registered by the server in this release regardless of this value.

environmentVariables.name: WORKEL_SKIP_STARTUP_CHECK
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to skip the GET /me startup probe and start immediately with every tool this key's scopes could ever reach, without confirming which scopes the key actually carries right now.

environmentVariables.name: WORKEL_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: One of debug, info, warn, error (case-insensitive). Defaults to info.
